verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a compliance and security platform, since some products of this kind ship self-hostable editions, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents a self-hosted or on-prem deployment of Oneleet. All documented access, including the API, the MCP server and the web app, runs through Oneleet's hosted service at api.oneleet.com.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
